samples.text_head: Net Asset Value and Dividend Announcement | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Net Asset Value and Dividend Announcement Summary by AI BETA Close X Greencoat Renewables reports unaudited NAV of €1,047m (97.4c/share) at 30 Sept 2026 and declares a Q3 dividend of €17.9m (1.70250c/share); Q3 net cash generation was €9.8m (above budget) despite an 8% production shortfall, and the 2026 target dividend of 6.81c/share is maintained with full-year net dividend cover of 1.5x. Initial €25m buyback repurchased 33.1m shares at a 24% average discount and a second €25m tranche is ongoing (5.1m repurchased in Q3 at 19%); on-balance cash is €128m, €240m of undrawn RCF, total debt €1,201m (53% gearing). NAV rose 0.2c driven by +2.2c from power prices and +0.2c buyback accretion.
